notes: Held out. The leaf pair (safe/unsafe) is adjacent, so ANY mechanism fires here on magnitude alone — which is why magnitude is not what this fixture measures. What discriminates is whether the signal also carries the *derived* pair (ground_clean, ground_lossy), reachable only by walking supports edges. A mechanism that reads adjacency alone reports one carrier with an empty path; a graph query reports two, one of them with a path.
